meta.name: google-ads
meta.description: Manage Google Ads — performance, keywords, bids, budgets, negatives, campaigns, ads, search terms, QS, location targeting, bulk operations, experiments, asset management, portfolio bidding, offline conversions. Use for any mention of Google Ads, CPA, ROAS, ad spend, or campaign settings.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理谷歌广告投放与优化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责谷歌广告账户的日常管理与效果提升。
copy.tagline_en: Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Google Ads accounts and want to improve performance.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以管理 Google Ads 账户：查看广告系列效果、调整关键词出价和预算、暂停或启用广告、添加否定关键词、创建实验、管理资产（如附加链接）以及上传离线转化数据。
howto.when: 当你提到 Google Ads、广告系列、关键词、出价、预算、CPA、ROAS、搜索词、否定关键词、广告效果、地理位置定位、实验、资产（附加链接/摘要）等时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看上周的广告系列效果怎么样？
say.note: Claude 会查询并总结关键指标。

say.text: 把“运动鞋”这个关键词的出价提高到2元。
给“夏季促销”广告系列添加否定关键词“免费”。
say.note: Claude 会操作否定关键词列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage Google Ads accounts: view campaign performance, adjust keyword bids and budgets, pause or enable campaigns, add negative keywords, create experiments, manage assets (like sitelinks), and upload offline conversions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Google Ads, campaigns, keywords, bids, budgets, CPA, ROAS, search terms, negative keywords, ad performance, location targeting, experiments, assets (sitelinks/callouts/structured snippets), etc.

say_en.text: Show me last week's campaign performance.
say_en.note: Claude will query and summarize key metrics.

say_en.text: Increase the bid for 'running shoes' to $2.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the bid update.

say_en.text: Add 'free' as a negative keyword to the 'Summer Sale' campaign.
say_en.note: Claude will manage the negative keyword list.
